ja521:2.1: Vessantaran taṃ pucchāmi, sakuṇa bhaddam atthu te, rajjaṃ kāretukāmena kiṃ su kiccaṃ kataṃ varan ti.
ja521:3.1: Cirassaṃ vata maṃ tāto Kaṃso Bārāṇasiggaho pamatto appamattaṃ maṃ pitā puttaṃ acodayīti.
ja521:4.1: Paṭhamen' eva vitathaṃ kodhaṃ hāsaṃ nivāraye, tato kiccāni kāreyya, taṃ vataṃ āhu khattiya.
ja521:5.1: Yaṃ tvaṃ tāta tape kammaṃ pubbe katam asaṃsayaṃ ratto duṭṭho ca yaṃ kayirā na taṃ kayirā tato punaṃ.
ja521:6.1: Khattiyassa pamattassa raṭṭhasmiṃ raṭṭhavaddhana sabbe bhogā vinassanti, rañño taṃ vuccate aghaṃ.
ja521:7.1: Sirī ca tāta Lakkhī ca pucchitā etad abravuṃ: uṭṭhānaviriye pose ram' āhaṃ anusuyyake.
ja521:8.1: Ussuyyake duhadaye purise kammadussake kālakaṇṇī mahārāja ramati cakkabhañjanī.
ja521:9.1: So [tvaṃ] sabbesaṃ suhadayo sabbesaṃ rakkhito bhava, alakkhiṃ nuda mahārāja lakkhī bhava nivesanaṃ.
ja521:10.1: Salakkhi dhitisampanno puriso hi mahaggato amittānaṃ Kāsipati mūlaṃ aggañ ca chindati.
ja521:11.1: Sakko pi hi bhūtapati uṭṭhāne na-ppamajjati sa kalyāṇe dhitiṃ katvā uṭṭhāne kurute mano.
ja521:12.1: Gandhabbā pitaro devā sañjīvā honti tādino, uṭṭhahato appamajjato anutiṭṭhanti devatā.
ja521:13.1: So appamatto akkuṭṭho tāta kiccāni kāraye vāyamassu ca kiccesu, nālaso vindate sukhaṃ.
ja521:14.1: Tatth' eva te vattapadā esā ca anusāsanī alaṃ mitte sukhāpetuṃ amittānaṃ dukkhāya cā 'ti.
ja521:15.1: Sakkhī tuvaṃ Kuṇḍalini maññasi khattiyabandhunī: rajjaṃ kāretukāmena kiṃ su kiccaṃ kataṃ varan ti g. ā.
ja521:16.1: Dve va tāta padakāni yesu sabbaṃ patiṭṭhitaṃ aladhassa ca yo lābho laddhassa anurakkhanā.
ja521:17.1: Amacce tāta jānāhi dhīre atthassa kovide anakkh' ākitave tāta asoṇḍe avināsake.
ja521:18.1: Yo ca taṃ tāta rakkheyya dhanaṃ yañ c' eva te siyā sūto va rathaṃ saṃgaṇhe so te {kiccāni} kāraye.
ja521:19.1: Susaṃgahītantajano sayaṃ cittaṃ avekkhiya nidhiñ ca iṇadānañ ca na kare parapattiyā.
ja521:20.1: Sayaṃ āyavayaṃ jaññā, sayaṃ jaññā katākataṃ, niggaṇhe niggahārahaṃ, paggaṇhe paggahārahaṃ.
ja521:21.1: Sayaṃ jānapadaṃ atthaṃ anusāsa rathesabha, mā te adhammikā yuttā dhanaṃ raṭṭhañ ca nāsayuṃ.
ja521:22.1: Mā ca vegena kiccāni kāresi kārayesi vā, vegasā hi kataṃ kammaṃ mando pacchānutappati.
ja521:23.1: Mā te avisare muñca subāḷham adhikodhitaṃ, kodhasā hi bahū pi tā kulā akulataṃ gatā.
ja521:24.1: Mā tāta issaro 'mhīti anatthāya patārayi, itthīnaṃ purisānañ ca mā te āsi dukhudrayo.
ja521:25.1: Apetalomahaṃsassa rañño kāmānusārino sabbe bhogā vinassanti, rañño taṃ vuccate aghaṃ.
ja521:26.1: Tatth' eva te vattapadā esā ca anusāsanī, dakkh' assu dāni puññakaro asoṇḍo avināsako, sīlav' assu mahārāja, dussīlo vinipātako ti.
ja521:27.1: Apucchamhāpi kosikaṃ Kuṇḍaliniñ ca tath' eva, Jambuka tvaṃ dāni vadehi balānaṃ balam uttaman ti g. ā.
ja521:28.1: Balaṃ pañcavidhaṃ loke purisasmiṃ mahaggate, tattha bāhābalaṃ nāma carimaṃ vuccate balaṃ,
ja521:29.1: bhogabalañ ca dīghāvu dutiyaṃ vuccate balaṃ, Amaccabalañ ca dīghāvu tatiyaṃ vuccate balaṃ,
ja521:30.1: abhijaccabalañ c' eva taṃ catutthaṃ asaṃsayaṃ, yāni c' etāni sabbāni adhigaṇhāti paṇḍito
ja521:31.1: Taṃ balānaṃ balaṃ seṭṭhaṃ aggaṃ paññābalaṃ balaṃ, paññābalen' upatthaddho atthaṃ vindati paṇḍito.
ja521:32.1: Api ce labhati mando phītaṃ dharaṇim uttamaṃ akāmassa pasayhaṃ vā añño taṃ paṭipajjati.
ja521:33.1: Abhijāto pi ce hoti rajjaṃ laddhāna khattiyo duppañño hi Kāsipati sabbena pi na jīvati.
ja521:34.1: Paññā sutavinicchinī paññā [kitti] silokavaddhanī, paññāsahito naro idha [api] dukkhe sukhāni vindati.
ja521:35.1: Paññañ ca kho asussūsaṃ na koci adhigacchati bahussutaṃ anāgamma dhammaṭṭhaṃ avinibbhujaṃ.
ja521:36.1: Yo dhammañ ca vibhāgaññū kāluṭṭhāyī atandito anuṭṭhahati kālena kammaphalaṃ tassa ijjhati.
ja521:37.1: Nānāyatanasīlassa nānāyatanasevino na nibbindiyakārissa samma-d-attho vipaccati.
ja521:38.1: Ajjhattañ ca payuttassa tathāyatanasevino anibbindiyakārissa samma-d-attho vipaccati.
ja521:39.1: Yogappayogasaṃkhātaṃ sambhatassānurakkhanaṃ tāni tvaṃ tāta sevassu, mā akammāya randhayi, akammanā hi dummedho naḷāgāraṃ va sīdatīti.
ja521:40.1: Dhammañ cara mahārāja mātāpitusu khattiya, (IV p. 421.) (cfr. Mahāvastu I p.) idha dhammaṃ caritvāna rāja saggaṃ gamissasi.
ja521:41.1: Dhammañ cara mahārāja puttadāresu khattiya --pe--. Dhammañ cara mahārāja mittāmaccesu
ja521:45.1: Dhammañ cara mahārāja raṭṭhe janapadesu ca --pe--.
ja521:47.1: Dhammañ cara mahāraja migapakkhisu khattiya --pe--. Dhammañ cara mahārāja, dhammo
ja521:48.1: ciṇṇo sukhāvaho, idha dhammaṃ caritvāna rāja saggaṃ gamissasi.
ja521:49.1: Dhammañ cara mahārāja Indo devā sabrahmakā suciṇṇena divaṃ pattā, mā dhammaṃ rāja pamādo
ja521:50.1: ti. Tatth' ev' ete vattapadā esā ca anusāsanī sappaññe sevi kalyāṇi samattaṃ sāmataṃ vidū ti.
